parent_objective: implement bounded measured fixed-policy source mining from M1530 design
blocked_by: measured source-mining runner is needed before source candidates can be audited
supersedes: candidate materialization from dry planner metadata

public_gates: M1531 must implement bounded measured fixed-policy mining
M1531 must write measured traces pair candidates intervention rows summaries and guardrails
M1531 must keep candidate materialization and training blocked
M1531 must not use private holdout or alter actor inputs
M1531 must route to audit before any corpus export
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from measured smoke

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements bounded measured fixed-policy source mining and writes public smoke artifacts for later audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure and bounded public measured smoke only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation changes actor input contract
stop if source diversity collapses to closed T5 rows
stop if candidate rows are materialized
stop if measured smoke routes directly to training
fallback_plan: audit as scenario_sampling_failure if measured pairs are absent
repair measured runner if artifacts or guardrails are incomplete
audit before any materialization even if measured positives appear

admission_evidence: M1530 defined measured trace schema pairing metrics intervention variants and guardrails
allowed_updates: measured mining module and focused tests
M1531 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: guardrail summary is clean or failures explicit
measured pair count and source diversity are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1531 measured smoke may find reset/zero-current sensitivity but must not claim self-ID without wrong-history or donor-response evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1531 bounded public measured smoke only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured mining finds no source-diverse ambiguity, record the negative result and audit before retargeting.
allowed_claims: M1531 implements measured mining plumbing and public smoke
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded measured fixed-policy miner can produce public trace, pairing, intervention, and guardrail artifacts from the M1528 source grid without materializing candidates.
success_criteria: focused tests cover schema guardrails and bounded summary behavior
bounded smoke writes required measured artifacts and summary.json
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: measured mining module or smoke artifacts are missing
implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation materializes candidates or starts training/replay/PPO
decision_rule: M1531 passes if bounded measured mining artifacts are written and all no-materialization/no-training guardrails remain clean.
